title: Benchmarking LLM-as-a-Judge for Long-Form Output Evaluation
authors_zh: Junjie Chen, Yuxi Dong, Haitao Li, Weihang Su, Yujia Zhou, Min Zhang, Yiqun Liu, Qinyao Ai
paper_type_zh: 污染、验证器、奖励或评测可靠性审计
best_for_zh: 需要评测报告、计划或长回答的自动评审器研究者。
one_line: Long-form judge benchmark emphasizing protocol-dependent reliability.
以跨场景、跨协议基准检验 LLM 评审器对长文本输出的稳定性。
why: It adds a concrete reliability or failure-mode evaluation surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: contamination, verifier/reward failure, reward hacking, or evaluator reliability.

title: Problem
问题
html: Long-form outputs require document-level judgements of organization, coverage, consistency, and scenario-specific criteria, but existing judge benchmarks mostly test short answers. LongJudgeBench measures whether LLM judges remain reliable under these demands. Short-output benchmarks average under 500 tokens and do not cover report structure, cross-section consistency, depth, or document elements. Long-form judging also expands context with references and rubrics, creating order bias, overflow, and safety refusals that ordinary accuracy can conceal. The authors do not define long form as a length threshold alone: a judge must handle instruction, one or more documents, reference judgment, and optional auxiliary fields. Gold labels can be scores, preferences, rankings, or answer verification, so original protocols must survive normalization.

长文本需要判断结构、覆盖度、一致性和场景特定标准，而现有评审基准主要测试短答案。LongJudgeBench 测量 LLM 评审器在这些要求下是否仍可靠。 短输出基准的候选文本平均不足 500 token，无法覆盖真实报告的结构、跨段一致性、深度与文档元素；而长文本评审还会因参考资料、rubric 与安全策略扩大上下文，导致顺序偏差、溢出和拒答等普通准确率掩盖的失败。 作者并不把长文本定义为单纯长度阈值，而是要求评审处理 instruction、一个或多个候选文档、参考判断及可选辅助字段。不同任务的金标可为直接分数、偏好、排序或答案验证，故必须在统一格式下保留原有协议。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: LongJudgeBench is a 1,944-instance, 1,966-output meta-evaluation benchmark for long-form judging, with a 9,249.7-token mean candidate length. It normalizes instruction, content, and response while retaining pointwise, pairwise, and listwise protocols across six datasets from five scenarios. Authors release code, self-collected data, annotations, metadata, outputs, and protocols under MIT where permitted. RealDeepResearch contains 40 research tasks, four prompt styles, and four generation models, yielding 640 long documents and preserving DOCX. Other scenarios cover surveys, writing, long-chain analysis, and medical reviews; normalization tests one judge under common extraction and comparison rules without erasing task differences.

LongJudgeBench 是含 1,944 个实例、1,966 个输出的长文本元评测基准，候选输出平均 9,249.7 个 token。它统一 instruction、content、response 格式，同时保留六个数据集、五类场景中的点式、成对和列表式协议。作者在许可允许时以 MIT 发布代码、自采数据、标注、元数据、输出和协议。 其中 RealDeepResearch 由 40 个研究任务、4 种提示风格和 4 个生成模型构成 640 篇长文档，并保留 DOCX；其余场景覆盖综述、创作、长链分析与医学系统综述。统一并非抹平任务差异，而是让同一评审器在相同抽取与比较规则下接受检验。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect six datasets across deep research, scientific survey, creative writing, long-chain analysis, and systematic review; preserve their protocols while normalizing every instance into instruction, content, and response.
  1. Instructions carry the source query, protocol, and optional rubric, weights, references, constraints, or formatting; the judge returns rationale plus an extracted score, preference, or ranking.
  1. Evaluate eight base-model judges at temperature 0 under Vanilla, Rubric, Reference, and Reference+Rubric settings.
  1. Compare predictions with expert reference judgements using accuracy, Spearman, and Kendall; pairwise items are judged in both orders to reduce position bias.

1. 汇集深度研究、科学综述、创意写作、长链分析和系统综述中的六个数据集；保留原协议，同时把每个实例统一为 instruction、content、response。
  1. instruction 包含源问题、协议以及可选 rubric、权重、参考材料、约束或格式；评审器返回理由及可提取的分数、偏好或排序。
  1. 在 Vanilla、Rubric、Reference、Reference+Rubric 四种设置下，以温度 0 测试八个基础模型评审器。
  1. 用 accuracy、Spearman、Kendall 与专家参考判断比较；成对样本交换两种顺序以降低位置偏差。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The main experiment evaluates 32 model–setting combinations on the six-dataset benchmark. The best, Qwen3-Max+Reference, reaches 0.6721 average accuracy; the 32-way mean is 0.5627. Reference improves the average from 0.5313 (Vanilla) to 0.5843 and Verify from 0.5491 to 0.8169, but Reference+Rubric falls to 0.5784. This shows auxiliary context is helpful but not uniformly additive.

主实验对六数据集上的 32 个模型—设置组合进行评测。最佳 Qwen3-Max+Reference 的平均 accuracy 为 0.6721，32 组合平均仅 0.5627。Reference 将平均分从 Vanilla 的 0.5313 提升到 0.5843，并将 Verify 从 0.5491 提升到 0.8169，但 Reference+Rubric 降至 0.5784。这说明辅助上下文有用，却不会稳定叠加。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Short-form meta-evaluation treats output length as the main variation. LongJudgeBench changes the evaluation surface to document-level organization, coverage, depth, cross-section consistency, and scenario-specific criteria. Its novelty is benchmark breadth across long-form protocols, not a new judge model. Its distinction from Long-form RewardBench is not merely length: much of the latter’s gold data comes from an LLM-as-a-judge pipeline, which can create circularity. LongJudgeBench uses expert direct scores, preferences, rankings, and reference verification, retaining protocols in a unified format; its audit object is judge–human agreement.

短文本元评测常把长度视作主要变化。LongJudgeBench 将评测面改为文档级结构、覆盖、深度、跨段一致性和场景标准。新意在于覆盖多种长文本协议的基准广度，而非新评审模型。 与 Long-form RewardBench 的区别不只是文本更长：后者多数金标由 LLM-as-a-judge 管线生成，可能形成循环偏差；LongJudgeBench 用专家直接评分、偏好、排序和参考验证作金标，并把不同协议保留在统一实例格式中，审计对象是评审器与人类判断的一致性。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors state that six scenarios cannot cover all real-world long-form tasks and that retrieval-augmented and multi-agent judges remain untested. The benchmark also exposes operational failures: context overflow and safety refusals invalidate scores, while GPT-4o-mini has 78.7% order inconsistency on WP-Bench. Reuse therefore needs target-domain coverage and failure logging, not only aggregate accuracy. Even the best setting reaches only 0.6721 accuracy, so the benchmark exposes a reliability gap rather than supplying a human substitute. The paper counts overflow and refusal as incorrect; dropping those cases in replication would overstate deployment reliability.

作者指出六类场景仍无法覆盖所有真实长文本任务，检索增强和多智能体评审器也尚未测试。基准还暴露运行失败：上下文溢出和安全拒答会使评分无效；GPT-4o-mini 在 WP-Bench 的顺序不一致率为 78.7%。复用须检查目标领域覆盖与失败日志，不能只看平均 accuracy。 此外，最佳设置也只达到 0.6721 accuracy，说明基准的主要价值是暴露可靠性缺口而非提供可直接替代人工的裁判。原文把溢出和拒答计为错误；复现时若悄悄丢弃这些样本，会夸大实际部署可靠性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: A team evaluating reports, plans, or long answers can use LongJudgeBench to select a judge and protocol by scenario, then check agreement and stability rather than only an average score. Do not transfer a winning configuration to a new genre without human spot checks. For selection, Reference’s mean gain does not mean every task should add it: its gain on RealDR is limited, and combining it with a rubric does not beat Reference alone. Without reliable references, report Vanilla and Rubric scenario scores rather than manufacture an anchor.

评测报告、计划或长回答的团队可用 LongJudgeBench 按场景选择评审器和协议，并检查一致性与稳定性，而非只看平均分。新文体仍须抽样人工核验，不能直接迁移胜出配置。 对模型选择而言，Reference 的平均提升不代表所有任务都应加入参考：它在 RealDR 上收益有限，且与 rubric 联用并未超过单独 Reference。若任务没有可靠参考材料，应优先报告 Vanilla 与 Rubric 的场景分数，而不是人为补造锚点。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: a long-form judge is tested on 1,944 instances, not assumed reliable from short benchmarks.
  1. Object: instruction–content–response records preserve pointwise, pairwise, and listwise protocols.
  1. Scale: six datasets, five scenarios, 1,966 outputs, 9,249.7 mean tokens.
  1. Evidence: best accuracy is 0.6721; Reference helps, but Ref.+Rubric is worse than Reference alone.
  1. Reuse: swap answer order and log overflow/refusal before trusting a target judge.

1. 定位：在 1,944 个实例上测试长文本评审器，而不从短基准假定其可靠。
  1. 对象：instruction–content–response 记录保留点式、成对和列表协议。
  1. 规模：六数据集、五场景、1,966 个输出、平均 9,249.7 token。
  1. 证据：最高 accuracy 仅 0.6721；Reference 有效，但 Ref.+Rubric 不如单独 Reference。
  1. 复用：先交换答案顺序，并记录溢出/拒答，再信任目标评审器。
